items.key: here in new york
items.ko: 여긴 뉴욕입니다.
items.en: Here in New York

items.key: life is filled with precious moments ones that we wish we could hang on to forever
items.ko: 삶은 소중한 순간들로 가득 차 있죠. 평생 붙잡고 싶은 순간들 말이에요.
items.en: Life is filled with precious moments, ones that we wish we could hang on to forever.

items.key: but our ability to recall everything no matter how much it means to us gets worse and worse over time
items.ko: 하지만 아무리 우리에게 소중한 기억이라도, 모든 것을 기억해 내는 능력은 시간이 지날수록 점점 떨어집니다
items.en: But our ability to recall everything, no matter how much it means to us, gets worse and worse over time.

items.key: and if you dont have an accurate record you may never be able to trust your own version of events
items.ko: 그리고 정확한 기록이 없다면, 자신이 기억하는 일이 정말 사실인지 영영 확신하지 못할 수도 있죠.
items.en: And if you don't have an accurate record, you may never be able to trust your own version of events.

items.key: then youll just end up remembering things someone else wants you to
items.ko: 결국 남들이 기억하라는 대로 기억하게 되는 거죠.
items.en: Then you'll just end up remembering things someone else wants you to.

items.key: but it doesnt have to be this way so stick with me
items.ko: 하지만 꼭 이럴 필요는 없죠. 그러니 계속 지켜봐 주세요.
items.en: But it doesn't have to be this way, so stick with me.

items.key: ill show you how to turn every waking moment into something thats impossible to forget
items.ko: 깨어 있는 모든 순간을 절대 잊을 수 없는 특별한 기억으로 만드는 방법을 알려드릴게요.
items.en: I'll show you how to turn every waking moment into something that's impossible to forget.

items.key: a good memory is one of the most attractive qualities that people can have
items.ko: 기억력이 좋다는 것은 사람이 가질 수 있는 가장 매력적인 자질 중 하나입니다.
items.en: A good memory is one of the most attractive qualities that people can have.

items.key: my memory is not very good and it always made me feel insecure
items.ko: 저는 기억력이 별로 좋지 않아서, 그게 항상 저를 불안하고 자신감 없게 만들었어요.
items.en: My memory is not very good, and it always made me feel insecure.

items.key: its kind of why i started to shoot so much video
items.ko: 그게 제가 영상을 그렇게 많이 찍기 시작한 이유이기도 해요.
items.en: It's kind of why I started to shoot so much video.

items.key: as possible writing down every single thing i do every single day for decades now
items.ko: 가능한 한 많이 기록하면서, 수십 년 동안 매일매일 제가 하는 모든 일을 하나하나 적어왔어요.
items.en: as possible, writing down every single thing I do every single day for decades now.

items.key: even though i knew exactly what i wanted i had a really hard time finding something in the store
items.ko: 내가 뭘 원하는지 정확히 알고 있었는데도, 매장에서 물건을 찾는 데 정말 애를 먹었어요.
items.en: Even though I knew exactly what I wanted, I had a really hard time finding something in the store.

items.key: the only available employee was a security robot
items.ko: 도움을 요청할 수 있는 유일한 직원은 보안 로봇뿐이었어요.
items.en: The only available employee was a security robot.

items.key: still the staff was preoccupied because someone had actually run out of the store with a bunch of groceries without paying and nobody knew what to do
items.ko: 하지만 직원들은 다른 일로 정신이 없었어요. 누군가 식료품을 잔뜩 들고 계산도 하지 않은 채 가게 밖으로 도망쳐 버렸고, 아무도 어떻게 해야 할지 몰랐거든요.
items.en: Still, the staff was preoccupied because someone had actually run out of the store with a bunch of groceries without paying, and nobody knew what to do.

items.key: the robot looked trustworthy and wise i couldnt believe that such a sophisticated piece of technology would allow a robbery to take place in broad daylight
items.ko: 그 로봇은 믿음직스럽고 똑똑해 보였어요. 그렇게 정교한 첨단 기술을 갖춘 로봇이 대낮에 강도 사건이 벌어지는 걸 막지 못했다니 믿을 수 없었죠.
items.en: The robot looked trustworthy and wise. I couldn't believe that such a sophisticated piece of technology would allow a robbery to take place in broad daylight.

items.key: maybe it was not programmed to do
items.ko: 아마 그걸 하도록 프로그래밍되어 있지 않았던 것 같아요.
items.en: Maybe it was not programmed to do

items.key: i tried to buy as much as i could from the list but i couldnt find any zagnut bars
items.ko: 전 목록에 있는 물건들을 최대한 사려고 했지만, 재그넛 바는 하나도 찾을 수 없었어요.
items.en: I tried to buy as much as I could from the list, but I couldn't find any Zagnut bars.

items.key: he was the creator of the inventory software used to organize everything
items.ko: 매장의 모든 물품을 체계적으로 관리하는 데 사용되는 재고 관리 소프트웨어를 만든 사람이었어요.
items.en: he was the creator of the inventory software used to organize everything.

items.key: i specifically remember this being called stouffers but its always been known as kraft stouffers its always been this way since the 1970s its been kraft
items.ko: 저는 분명히 이게 '스토퍼스'라고 불렸던 걸 기억해요. 그런데 알고 보니 원래부터 '크래프트 스토퍼스'였다는 거예요. 1970년대부터 계속 그랬다고 하더라고요.
items.en: I specifically remember this being called "Stouffer's," but it's always been known as "Kraft Stouffer's." It's always been this way since the 1970s. It's been Kraft.

items.key: i definitely thought febreze had more es in it
items.ko: 저는 페브리즈라는 이름에 E가 더 많이 들어가는 줄 알았어요.
items.en: I definitely thought Febreze had more E's in it.

items.key: im gonna bring one up
items.ko: 제가 하나 꺼내 볼게요. / 제가 하나 언급해 볼게요
items.en: I'm gonna bring one up.

items.key: i still havent gotten all my groceries
items.ko: 장도 아직 다 못 봤지만
items.en: I still haven't gotten all my groceries.

items.key: because i had made it up
items.ko: 왜냐하면 내가 그걸 지어냈기 때문이야.
items.en: Because I had made it up.
